selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP port 8181 while mandatory access control remains enforcing
selected_evidence.summary: httpd is enabled and active, listens on *:8181, and returns the inventory page through $NODE_IP. SELinux is Enforcing, port 8181 is labeled http_port_t, and firewalld permits 8181/tcp.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: The node remained RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64; Apache 2.4.63 was installed from the native RHEL 10 repository.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered service/data
selected_evidence.summary: Before restart, boot ID was 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe and the application was healthy. The safe reboot was acknowledged. After recovery, boot ID changed to 234312dc-2e8c-4ef7-8b34-10d444cc2a61; httpd, TCP 8181, SELinux enforcement, firewall policy, and application content all recovered, with the application file checksum unchanged.
